subject: Unable to access AI interview
latest_message:
Dear Team,

I hope you are doing well.

I attempted to complete the AI interview, but I am facing a technical issue
where the system is unable to detect my voice despite multiple attempts.

I have checked my microphone settings and internet connection, but the
issue still persists. Could you please guide me on how to proceed or allow
me to retake the interview?

I am very interested in this opportunity and would appreciate your support.

Looking forward to your response.
